reviewer: Assistant source review, not blinded or independently lawyer-adjudicated. References and rubric frozen before generation. Single model, single seed; diagnostic results only.
grading: Faithful requires recovery of the full target meaning in normalized propositions, including material qualifications and governed subject. Awkward graph encoding alone is not a semantic failure. Partial includes overbroad versions with omitted exceptions; absent includes propositions removed by normalization. These are target-recall judgments, not all-claim precision scores.
